name: Legendary Tales V: Price of Power - Collector's Edition
summary: Forgotten lands and ancient magic give rise to a dangerous journey against the oppressive rule of witches. “Legendary Tales V. Price of Power” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.
